Players Committee card image of [[CC-2237 (Odd Ball)]] (original printing), game text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Droid starfighters are power and forfeit -1 here. During battle, may add or subtract 1 from a just drawn even destiny.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Light/large/cc2237oddball.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
